pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Alexandre Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's d4 in a Black plan; rewritten around the half-open f-file after ...fxe4. The overview now names 5.d4 as the testing reply; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Center Holding Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 aimed ...a5-a4 at a 'c3-knight' (c3 holds a pawn) and a b2-pawn; rewritten around keeping the b6-bishop safe from a4-a5. Plan 2 dropped a ...d5 break that doesn't fit the line. British spelling, including the opening's name in the overview.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Closed Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 met d4 with ...exd4, missing the point of 4...Qe7 (5.d4 Bb6 keeps e5); rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Tarrasch Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 onto Black's e5-pawn; rewritten around Nbd2-f1-g3, d4-d5 and a4-a5. Plan 4 sent the c6-knight to e7, where the queen stands (caught by the reviewer); now ...Na5 or ...Nd8-e6. British spelling.

pages.name: Giuoco Pianissimo: 5.d3 d6 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1 (now after Re1); plan 4 rerouted the f6-knight via e7-g6 (it is the c6-knight). British spelling.

pages.name: Giuoco Piano: 6.cxd4 Bb4+ 7.Bd2
pages.notes: Plan 3 assumed ...Bxd2+ Qxd2 and queenside expansion (8.Nbxd2 is the move, and ...d5 leaves White an isolated d4-pawn). Rewrote the overview and all four plans around the isolated-pawn position.

pages.name: Giuoco Piano: Albin Gambit
pages.notes: The overview had Black sacrificing a pawn by taking on e4; White's 5.O-O is the gambit. Plans gave the extra pawn to White and played Nc3 with a pawn on c3. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Ghulam-Kassim Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...d5 onto White's d5-bishop; rewritten around ...cxb2, ...Ne7 and ...h5-h4. British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed Black's knight via ...Nbd7-f8-g6 (Black's knight is on c6); plan 1's Nbd2-f1-g3 came before Re1. Both rewritten; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight from b1 (it is on d2) via f1 with the rook still there; rewritten with Re1 first. British spelling.
